intermediate.reason: Independent peer evidence also accepted two mixed editable/semantic-region boxes from existing negative cases. Added a readonly uncontested local collection boundary; did not change those frozen tests.

changes: Follow the first content sibling through at most three plain div wrapper ascents only when outside that branch has no other controls, editable content, or semantic-region boundary.
Do not skip an intervening sibling and do not borrow headings inside another section/article/form/interactive control.
A fixed guide/manual download heading can identify reading context; a generic program download heading cannot.

A semantic readonly list/tablist can identify education reading from at least two and a strict majority of fixed educational concept peers, each ordinary same-origin navigate link without dangerous commands, article paths, document references, or conflicting task endpoints.
A collection mixed with editable content, another local semantic region, or other local controls does not acquire independent peer meaning.
Explicit help/FAQ purpose remains help; issuance preparation and academic calendar mode precedence remain unchanged.
Peer names, actions and destinations plus associated headings are recorded in supplemental snapshots to invalidate changes between analyses.
limits: No arbitrary semantic section crossing. Academic collections can rely on their own peer meaning instead of borrowing unrelated section headings.
No claim of complete wrapper/layout coverage. Group size and depth limits stay bounded.
Peer inference requires ordinary same-origin navigation; original locate actions, cross-origin links and unresolved references do not become academic solely through peer text.
acceptanceClaim: NONE; root integrated/performance/accessibility/live/development/fresh independent validation still required.
